What does Aangan Studio do?: We do end-to-end interior design for homes and small offices across Pune and PCMC: space planning, materials, furniture, lighting, kitchens and wardrobes, and execution with our own contractors and vendors.
Which areas do you work in?: Pune city and PCMC, including Kothrud, Baner, Aundh, Wakad, Koregaon Park, Kalyani Nagar, Viman Nagar, Hadapsar, Magarpatta, NIBM, Pimple Saudagar and Hinjewadi. We do not currently work in Talegaon, Lonavala, Nashik, Mumbai or other cities.
Do you work outside Pune?: I'm sorry, we only work in Pune and PCMC right now, because our contractors and vendors are here.
Do you do office interiors?: Yes, for offices, clinics and studios up to about 3,000 square feet, including workstations, cabins, reception and common areas.
Do you do restaurants, hotels, shops or: Those are outside what we do. We would suggest a specialist for that kind of space.
Can you just give me ideas or advice for: We are a full-service studio, so we design and execute together. We do not offer advice-only or colour-and-styling-only visits.
Can you do just one room?: Yes, a bedroom or living room, as a complete redesign with materials, furniture and execution included.
Can you only supply furniture?: No, we do not source furniture without a design project.
Do you do Vastu consultation?: We build your Vastu needs into our designs, but we do not offer standalone Vastu advice.
Do you do structural work or move walls?: No. We are interior designers, not architects, so we do not move walls, change the structure or handle permits for structural changes.
Can you work in a rented flat?: Yes, as long as there are no structural changes.
How long does a project take?: Design takes about three to four weeks from the first consultation, and execution takes eight to sixteen weeks depending on the size of the project and how ready the site is.
